decisions.reason: The multi-model operator line complements the core garage door business at low holding cost, and with no evidence against it after several years the option stays open.
The solid wood door is still a niche with uncertain demand, but in configurable production it costs little to keep and it supports the one-source range, so it is not yet worth abandoning.
Its overlap with the other glazed industrial variants raises the chance of consolidation, but without clear negative results the low-cost option is kept for now.
The insulated glazed door fits the rising demand for energy efficiency, so its option value remains high relative to its small holding cost.
Its own-page presentation signals firm commitment, and nothing observed suggests its value will not be realized.
